name: /post-batch N — show N videos with file paths + captions inline (gate pressure)
goal: Add /post-batch [N] Telegram command (default N=5, max 10). Shows next N unposted captioned videos — each with file path, speaker, caption (hook+hashtags) as tap-to-copy code block, and /record command. Operator posts multiple videos in one session from their phone without switching commands.
rationale: Gate: 20 days, 0/30 posts. Operator must post ~1.5/day. Current workflow: /post-now → manual note → /caption → copy → post → /record. Post-batch collapses this to: /post-batch 5 → post 5 → /record each. Reduces friction, increases posting velocity.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits (commands.ts + index.ts) + 1 new validation script. Direct write.
